title: Keep-Alive Caching for the Hawkes process
venue_full: 39th Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2023)

problem_statement.en: In serverless (FaaS) platforms there is no fixed-size cache to fill: keeping a function image warm costs the provider resources per unit time, while evicting it causes cold-start latency at the next invocation. The relevant question is when it is worth keeping an object in the cache, not what to evict. TTL-style keep-alive policies used in practice (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions) are only worst-case 2-approximations (ski rental) when tuned on costs alone, and precise per-object optimal caching decisions were lacking.
problem_statement.zh: serverless（FaaS）平台沒有固定容量的 cache 需要填滿：函式映像保持 warm 需按時間支付 provider 資源成本，逐出後下一次呼叫則產生 cold start 延遲。關鍵問題是「何時值得把物件留在 cache」，而非「該逐出哪個物件」。實務採用的 TTL 式 keep-alive 政策（AWS Lambda、Azure Functions）若僅以成本調參，最壞情況只是 2-approximation（ski rental），且缺乏逐物件的精確最佳快取決策。

key_innovation.en: A cost model trading per-unit-time caching cost c_p against cache-miss cost c_cs, with optimal policies characterized by hazard-rate threshold crossings: keep-alive window boundaries lie at 0, infinity, or solutions of c_p − c_cs·λ(x|H) = 0 (Theorem 2). For Hawkes processes with exponential excitation this yields a closed-form history-dependent optimal window τ_opt = (1/β)(log α + log Σ_j e^{β(t_j−t_{m−1})} − log(c_p/c_cs − λ0)), plus a history-independent optimized-TTL heuristic (averaging optimal windows over simulated arrivals) backed by history-independent upper/lower bounds (Corollary 2.3).
key_innovation.zh: 以每單位時間快取成本 c_p 與 cache miss 成本 c_cs 的權衡建立成本模型，並以 hazard rate 門檻穿越刻劃最佳政策：keep-alive 視窗邊界落在 0、無窮大、或 c_p − c_cs·λ(x|H) = 0 的解（Theorem 2）。對具指數激發函數的 Hawkes process，導出依賴歷史的閉式最佳視窗 τ_opt = (1/β)(log α + log Σ_j e^{β(t_j−t_{m−1})} − log(c_p/c_cs − λ0))，並提出與歷史無關的 optimized-TTL 啟發式（對模擬到達的最佳視窗取平均），輔以與歷史無關的上下界（Corollary 2.3）。

baselines_compared: Fixed keep-alive (TTL) windows (5-120 min), Azure 10-min default keep-alive, Offline optimal (oracle)

key_improvements.en: On Azure Functions traces, applying the optimal policy to the 25% of applications best fit by a Hawkes process reduces cache resource use by ~4.5% on treated applications (0.95% overall) and saves ~1.012 cold starts per treated application per day versus length-tuned fixed policies; the history-independent optimized-TTL retains ~95% of the optimal policy's improvement. Offline optimal (oracle) bound: 4.038 cold-start savings / 0.269 memory savings on Hawkes applications.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Azure Functions trace 上，對最符合 Hawkes process 的 25% 應用套用最佳政策，可使受處理應用的 cache 資源使用降低約 4.5%（整體 0.95%），且相較逐視窗長度調參的固定政策，每個受處理應用每天平均減少約 1.012 次 cold start；與歷史無關的 optimized-TTL 保留最佳政策約 95% 的改進。offline optimal（oracle）上界：Hawkes 應用 cold start 節省 4.038 / 記憶體節省 0.269。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (no latency prediction; reports cost, cold-start, and wasted-memory savings relative to fixed keep-alive policies)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Hawkes via Ogata modified thinning; 600 arrivals x 100 realizations), Azure Functions trace (Shahrad et al. 2020; parameters fit on day 8, KS goodness-of-fit on day 7, evaluated on day 9)

scope_assumptions.en: Infinite-capacity cache (cost-based, not eviction-based): the provider can always dedicate more resources, so the decision is when to keep, not what to evict. Loading time/cost into the cache is assumed zero, making the cost formula a lower bound on true cost. The provider must know or estimate the arrival distribution; analysis is restricted to Poisson and Hawkes processes with exponential excitation, and the optimal Hawkes policy must be recomputed after every arrival. Azure evaluation assumes zero function execution time and uniform memory across applications, treats only the 25% of applications with best Hawkes goodness-of-fit (KS test), caps history at 200 previous arrivals, and evaluates a single day. Costs c_p and c_cs are provider-side model parameters uniform within each experiment — no client-declared lifecycle signals (TTLs, leases, or per-application cold-start costs) are used; per-customer customization is noted as future work. Targets serverless function-image caching, not LLM/KV caches.
scope_assumptions.zh: 無限容量 cache（基於成本而非逐出）：provider 永遠可投入更多資源，決策問題是「何時保留」而非「逐出哪個」。假設載入 cache 的時間與成本為零，成本公式因此是真實成本的下界。provider 需已知或可估計到達分布；分析限於 Poisson 與指數激發的 Hawkes process，且 Hawkes 最佳政策須在每次到達後重新計算。Azure 評估假設函式執行時間為零、所有應用記憶體相同，僅處理 Hawkes 適合度（KS 檢定）最佳的 25% 應用，歷史上限 200 次到達，且僅評估單日。成本 c_p 與 c_cs 為 provider 端模型參數且在單一實驗內一致——不使用任何客戶端宣告的生命週期訊號（TTL、lease 或每應用 cold start 成本）；逐客戶客製化被列為未來工作。標的為 serverless 函式映像快取，而非 LLM/KV cache。
